picks.reason: 2018 年代表性的 class language model 與 token-passing decoder 方法，涵蓋外部詞彙、解碼器整合及串流情境；可作為 decoder-side hotwording 的早期基準。venue 與被引資訊未提供。

picks.title: Contextual RNN-T For Open Domain ASR
picks.reason: 直接針對 Contextual RNN-T 與 open-domain ASR，適合分析 RNN-T 內部 contextual encoder、prediction network 或解碼流程的整合位置；2020 年代表性研究。venue 與被引資訊未提供。

picks.title: Fast Context-Biasing for CTC and Transducer ASR models with CTC-based Word Spotter
picks.reason: 2024 年提出 CTC-based Word Spotter，可分析外掛式或並行式 hotword 偵測、低延遲串流整合與效率評估，且可直接套用至具 CTC 輸出的 Zipformer/Transducer 系統。venue 與被引資訊未提供。

picks.title: WCTC-Biasing: Retraining-free Contextual Biasing ASR with Wildcard CTC-based Keyword Spotting and Inter-layer Biasing
picks.reason: 2025 年的 retraining-free WCTC-Biasing 結合 wildcard CTC keyword spotting 與 inter-layer biasing，直接對應動態熱詞、跨層架構整合及無需重新訓練的部署需求；對 Zipformer/CTC-Transducer 類系統具較高可移植性。venue 與被引資訊未提供。

Encoder contextual adaptation: updates acoustic representations through contextual attention or adapters; the supplied research notes identify this family but do not provide a P1-P4 representative.
CTC detection and post-processing: detects dynamic words using CTC-based modules and combines the result with ASR output; representative papers: Andrusenko et al., 2024, and Nakagome et al., 2025.
